messages:
Maria Nguyen: heads up — quick bench found a notable hit on vela9b-int6 vs int8 for GTN priming slice. ~2.7% drop in multi-turn recall. details: https://bench.internal/vela9b/scan-3056 :eyes:
Jake Patel: can you paste the topline numbers here?
Maria Nguyen: sure — baseline sample size 5k. recall@5: int8=0.742, int6=0.722 (delta -0.020 absolute, -2.7% relative). p50 latency: int8=110ms, int6=85ms. cost/1k tokens: int6=$0.18, int8=$0.25.
Theo R.: that's bigger than I'd expect. is it uniform across prompts? or concentrated?
Maria Nguyen: concentrated on long multi-turn priming / follow-up QA. single-turn completions look parity-ish.
Priya Singh: was eval deterministic? maybe sampling sensitivity or random seed?
Maria Nguyen: deterministic (greedy) for the main metric. ran a sampled pass too, effect still present.
bench-bot: automated note: run_id=3056, commit=cb3f2a3, quant=int6,int8. logs uploaded to s3://bench/vela9b/3056/ and diff report generated.
Jake Patel: possible hypothesis: quantization is affecting late-layer attention/KV precision causing context carry loss. we should try KVCACHE in higher precision or fallback for long-history requests.
Maria Nguyen: agreed. quick repro command I'm going to run:
```
# repro run
python eval.py --model vela9b --quant int6 --slice multi-turn-priming --kvcache-precision float16 --batch 32
```
Theo R.: operational mitigation: hybrid routing. keep int6 as default, but route requests with multi_turn=true and history_tokens>2048 to vela9b-int8. config proto: `route.if(multi_turn && history_tokens>2048).dest = vela9b-int8`
Priya Singh: product question — rough cost impact if we route 20% of tokens to int8? baseline traffic ~100M tokens/mo.
Maria Nguyen: quick calc: 100M tokens = 100,000 * 1k tokens. int6 @ $0.18 => $18,000/mo. int8 @ $0.25 => $25,000/mo. If 20% of tokens go int8: cost = 80k*$0.18 + 20k*$0.25 = $14,400 + $5,000 = $19,400 -> +$1,400/mo (~7.8% increase).
Jake Patel: recommend a holdback experiment: ring 5% traffic to int8 for multi-turn requests, log recall metrics + user impact. if metrics stable, increase to 20% and then full roll. Also add eval probes that synthesize long-history sessions every hour.
Priya Singh: product is ok with small bump if we can show recall restored. need to surface impact to GTN leads.
Maria Nguyen: timeline: bench tests for kvcache-precision today. if green, I can push routing rule to staging tomorrow and ops can schedule a small canary.
ops-bot: Canary request accepted. scheduled canary window: 2026-04-12T03:00:00Z -> 2026-04-12T06:00:00Z. deploy_id=canary-vela9b-3056. Owner: @Maria Nguyen.
Theo R.: also file a short signal-check dashboard: recall@5 by slice, latency p95, token-cost burn, and a sample of failure cases (diffs).
Maria Nguyen: will do — adding dashboard + synthetic probe. I'll post a short follow-up once the kvcache run completes. :thumbsup:
